title: Not a morning person
description: Un día normal en el piso de Maya y Jordan, y el tiempo de Chicago.

sentences.text: Maya and Jordan have an apartment in Logan Square, a neighborhood in Chicago.
sentences.es: Maya y Jordan tienen un piso en Logan Square, un barrio de Chicago.

sentences.text: It has two bedrooms, so Pablo sleeps on the couch.
sentences.es: Tiene dos dormitorios, así que Pablo duerme en el sofá.

sentences.text: Maya usually wakes up early, at six thirty.
sentences.es: Maya suele levantarse temprano, a las seis y media.

sentences.text: She takes a shower, has coffee and toast, and goes to work.
sentences.es: Se ducha, desayuna café con tostadas y se va a trabajar.

sentences.text: Jordan is the opposite: he's not a morning person.
sentences.es: Jordan es todo lo contrario: no es de mañanas.

sentences.text: «Please don't talk to me before ten!»
sentences.es: «¡Por favor, no me habléis antes de las diez!»

sentences.text: In the afternoon he works at the coffee shop, and at night he plays guitar.
sentences.es: Por la tarde trabaja en la cafetería y por la noche toca la guitarra.

sentences.text: Today, Pablo wants to go running in the park.
sentences.es: Hoy Pablo quiere ir a correr al parque.

sentences.text: «And it's going to rain this afternoon. Take an umbrella!»
sentences.es: «Y va a llover esta tarde. ¡Llévate un paraguas!»

sentences.text: Pablo looks out the window and stays on the couch with a movie.
sentences.es: Pablo mira por la ventana y se queda en el sofá con una peli.

questions.question: What time does Maya wake up?
What does Jordan do at night?

options.text: He works at the coffee shop.

questions.question: Why doesn't Pablo go running?
questions.es: ¿Por qué Pablo no sale a correr?

options.text: It's cold, and it's going to rain.
options.es: Hace frío y va a llover.
